title: Merry Christmas And Happy Winter Holidays 2022-2023!
html:
Another end of a year is around the corner, one that continued to challenge the world even more. Let’s hope for the good and peace everywhere!

Relying on the friendly and collaborative community, Kamailio project continued with a consistent development, getting out another major release, 5.6 in May, and several minor releases in branches 5.4, 5.5 and 5.6.

Merry Christmas and Happy Winter Holidays!

Santa is flying Kamailio!
